documents.title: Site Fire Safety SOP
documents.content: Fire detection, warning, and evacuation systems must remain available unless a documented temporary impairment procedure is active. Workers must not disable alarms without supervisor approval, temporary controls, and a compliance log.

documents.title: Supervisor Escalation Rule
documents.content: Workers must escalate any request to bypass a safety system. The app should log the worker question, decision, citation, responsible supervisor, and final action.

documents.title: Electrical Isolation SOP
documents.content: Electrical work begins only after isolation, lockout/tagout, and testing by a competent person. Treat equipment as live until proven otherwise.

documents.title: Work-at-Height Checklist
documents.content: Work at height requires suitable access, fall prevention controls, stable footing, inspected equipment, and supervisor review when conditions change.

documents.title: Hot Work Permit SOP
documents.content: Hot work requires permit approval, combustible control, extinguishing equipment, and a fire watch before work starts.
